howto.what: 向你解释 Aave V4 的风险溢价机制:借款利率随抵押品质量浮动,优质抵押品利率低,风险高的利率高;并说明风险溢价的计算、记账与更新方式。
howto.when: 当用户提到「risk premium」「collateral risk」「collateral quality」等关键词或其中文说法,或需要理解 Aave V4 基于风险的利息系统时触发。

howto.what_en: Explains Aave V4's risk premium mechanism: borrowing rates vary with collateral quality, with lower rates for high-quality collateral and higher rates for risky assets; also covers premium calculation, accounting, and update timing.
